description: This file defines utility methods and classes for managing JVM shutdown hooks within Apache Spark, including registration, removal, and execution of shutdown tasks with prioritization.

classes.name: SparkShutdownHookManager
classes.description: Manages registration and execution of shutdown hooks with prioritization.

classes.name: SparkShutdownHook
classes.description: Represents a shutdown hook with a priority, capable of being run and compared.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs a JVM shutdown hook that runs all registered hooks in order.

methods.name: runAll
methods.description: Executes all registered shutdown hooks in order.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Registers a new shutdown hook with a specified priority.
